hypothesis: Keep source transcription separate from syntax correction; compare visible PDF delimiters instead of only checking the normalized LaTeX draft.

replacements.old: Convert PDFs to Markdown while preserving LaTeX formulas and document structure. Uses the `marker_single` CLI from the marker-pdf package.
replacements.new: Convert PDFs to Markdown while preserving LaTeX formulas and document structure. Uses the `marker_single` CLI from the marker-pdf package. Treat converted or manually transcribed formulas as drafts: compare their visible symbols and delimiters against the source PDF before normalizing syntax. When corrections are requested, retain the source versions and append corrected versions separately. Valid LaTeX alone does not prove faithful transcription.
